equity.equity_measurement: Nationality counts are descriptive only; case definitions and surveillance methods differ between Saudi Arabia and Yemen, and the article says a direct comparison is precluded.

notes: A descriptive outbreak update: case proportions, a median age and mean durations, with no test or model. The Saudi-Yemen contrast is qualitative, and the article says a direct comparison is precluded. It also asserts a correlation between case areas and flood-irrigation areas with no stated method or statistic, so no procedure is recorded.
view_issues: Figure 1 is image-only and not described in the text; the correlation claim lacks any stated method.
